desc:
GRAHAM CRUNCH CEREAL: Delicious graham squares made with wheat, rice, oats and a sprinkle of sugar

NON-GMO: USDA certified organic non-GMO cereal

CROWD-PLEASING CEREAL: Snackers of all ages will love the sweet and satisfying crunch of this exceptional cereal

WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS: Made with 19 grams of whole grain

CONTAINS: 9.6 oz
features:
Key Features:

Organic Graham-Style Cereal

Made from whole grain wheat, rice flour, oats, and sweetened with organic cane sugar and molasses for a graham cracker-like flavor.

USDA Certified Organic

Free from synthetic pesticides and genetically modified ingredients.

Whole Grain Rich

Delivers about 16–19 grams of whole grains per serving, helping you meet your daily intake goals.

Simple Ingredients

Contains recognizable ingredients like whole grains, dextrose, baking soda, sunflower oil, and sea salt.

Benefits:

Crunchy and Flavorful

A satisfying graham crunch that appeals to both kids and adults—great with milk or on its own.

Digestive Health Support

The fiber and whole grains support healthy digestion and may help maintain stable energy levels.

Clean Eating Friendly

No artificial flavors, colors, or preservatives—ideal for health-conscious consumers.

Versatile

Enjoy it as cereal, a yogurt topper, or a grab-and-go snack.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat*, Cane Sugar*, Rice Flour*, Sunflower Oil*, Dextrose*, Molasses*, Baking Soda, Sea Salt. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. *Organic
